_note: PROVENANCE OF EVERY CLIP IN THE E1 (dark knight) BODY GLB; the source-fidelity / source-grid / loop-seam lint's input (nb_d2's rules, copied unchanged). Paths relative to wl_e1/.

edits.deroot: the hips' first-to-last horizontal line removed (45_deroot_trim's rule); hips translation only, not measured
edits.recentre: hips over the rest position -- loops on their mean, one-shots on their first frame (49_recentre's rule); hips translation only
edits.reground: one constant so the deepest foot vertex over the clip is on the floor (43_reground_all / gearlib.reground_from_feet mode 'min'); hips translation only
edits.trim: a window of the source, re-timed to start at 0; the measure aligns on it
edits.wrist_lock: 36/38/44: the wrists slerped toward a carry angle; the hands are excluded from the measure

_loop_rule: "loop": true marks the scene's looping clips: 21_lint_export.py's SOURCE GRID (keys on the source's own key times -- GLB or FBX, no exceptions) and LOOP SEAM (pose(0) vs pose(T) within 5 mm / 1 deg -- a source that is not periodic is blended, 58_loop_blend.py) judge them
